title: AI Techlead
description:
At a glance
Our AI team builds GenAI applications that go into production at one of the Netherlands' largest banks. Voice agents handling thousands of contact center calls. AI lending assistants supporting lenders in writing credit proposals. Agentic workflows that actually make it to users.
We don't stop at prototypes. We build, ship, measure, iterate, and do it fast. As an
AI Tech Lead
, you set the technical direction across these initiatives and stay close enough to the code to keep that pace honest. If you've got 7+ years of engineering experience, a serious track record of shipping AI in production, and you're looking to lead at a scale most companies won't give you for years, read on.
Your job
You set the technical direction on GenAI initiatives that span the bank: from the first conversation with a business team through to production and beyond. You decide how things get built, you build with the team, and you make sure the right things actually get done in a complex organisation. Your focus shifts with the use case: backend, frontend, from leveraging LLM’s to agentic. You own outcomes, not just architecture diagrams. You work directly with the people whose problems you're solving, and you bring the rest of the team along.
Concretely, you'll:
Set the technical direction for GenAI solutions across banking use cases: Voice AI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, document intelligence.
Drive initiatives end-to-end through a complex organisation: align stakeholders, unblock teams, make the calls that need to be made.
Co-create use cases with business counterparts: you understand the problem, not just the technology, and you shape what gets built.
Stay hands-on: design and write the hard parts if required.
Own architecture and technical quality across multiple workstreams: trade-offs, patterns, what we standardise on, what we don't.
Work with Agents, plain LLMs, code, Databricks and whatever the right tool is for the job.
Raise the technical bar of the team: code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, coaching mediors and juniors.
Working environment
You'll be part of a 25+ person AI team inside ABN AMRO's Innovation department. We operate with a startup mindset within a bank that serves millions of customers and employs thousands of individuals: fast feedback loops, direct lines to business leadership, and real deployment at scale. Amsterdam, hybrid.
Your profile
We don't hire on CV titles. We hire on what you've shipped and what you've led. The team includes people who came through software engineering, data science, infra — what they share is proven AI expertise and a bias for building over theorising. As a tech lead, you bring the same plus the ability to take an ambiguous problem and a group of strong engineers and turn it into something running in production.
What you've done:
Led the technical side of AI or software initiatives end-to-end: you've owned the architecture, made the hard calls, and shipped.
Built and deployed AI applications using LLMs, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, voice AI, or equivalent (at production scale, with real users).
Written Python that runs in production: you're a developer, not a notebook user, and you still enjoy writing the code.
Worked with cloud infrastructure: Azure preferred, AWS or GCP also fine.
Operated inside a complex organisation (or built the muscle elsewhere) and got things done across teams, not just within one.
How you work:
You take ambiguous problems, set a direction, and bring people with you (without waiting for permission).
You have strong technical opinions, formed through experience, and you're willing to defend them and change them.
You're as interested in the business problem as in the technical solution.
You explain your decisions clearly to people who don't share your context (engineers, business, leadership).
You follow the GenAI field closely because you're genuinely curious, not because you have to.
You've built something on the side (a tool, a project, a contribution) that shows you don't wait to be told what to learn.
We are offering
We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer:
An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36‑hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget which adds up to a range of €65.000 to €93.000 a year based on a 36-hour week (40 hours possible, pro-rated)
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.
You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.
Interested?
No motivation letter. Please answer these two questions instead:
Tell us about an AI initiative you led: what did you build, what calls did you make as the technical lead, and what did you learn when it hit production (or real users)?
What's the most interesting thing you've built or experimented with in AI in the last six months? Why does it matter to you?
Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.
The recruitmentprocess consists of an online personality assessment, an online culture interview, a technical case and an offline technical Interview.
Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable
At ABN AMRO, we believe in "
Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of
being a personal bank in the digital age
aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.
If you want to apply for the B-Able or Reboot program, make sure to mention it both in the title and the content of your resume.

title: Data engineer (focus op LLM)
description:
In het kort
Ben jij een IT-engineer en een enthousiaste persoonlijkheid die anderen inspireert om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren? Dan hebben we jouw hulp nodig om van ABN AMRO een persoonlijke bank te maken in een digitaal tijdperk!Hoe ga jij innovatie, vooruitgang en projecten binnen jouw afdeling vormgeven? Jij ondersteunt en begeleidt hen, zodat zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen tot technische experts die bijdragen aan een toekomstbestendige bank. Wij werken hybride, wat betekent dat jij en je team flexibel kunnen bepalen waar en wanneer jullie het meest comfortabel en effectief kunnen werken.Al met al betekent werken bij ABN AMRO dat je bijdraagt aan projecten die ertoe doen en impact hebben op miljoenen klanten! Ben jij klaar voor de uitdaging?
Je werk
Je wordt onderdeel van een team dat zich specifiek richt op toekomstbestendige technologieën en frameworks om de strategie en initiatieven van de bank te versnellen. In deze rol ga je modellen ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren die andere teams ondersteunen. Ook ga je werken aan de applicatie die andere de mogelijkheid biedt om te werken met AI modellen. De Document and Data Capture-applicatie classificeert en haalt gegevens uit documenten. Deze gegevens worden gebruikt voor verdere verwerking. Daarnaast vormen deze gegevens de basis van de AI-layer, die mogelijkheden biedt voor diverse use cases, zoals ‘Talk to your document’ en andere nieuwe proposities. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en beoordelen van softwareoplossingen die worden ingezet in de Azure Cloud met behulp van uiteenlopende technologieën, zoals Document Intelligence, AI search en OpenAI. Je maakt deel uit van een divers Agile/Scrum DevOps-team en hebt end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontwikkelen, beheren en onderhouden van functionaliteiten binnen het Enterprise Content Management-grid.

Bij ABN AMRO streven we ernaar om een persoonlijke bank te zijn in een digitaal tijdperk. Die strategie brengen we ook tot leven in de manier waarop we werken. Natuurlijk bieden we je de juiste middelen om een goede thuiswerkplek in te richten. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan een ergonomische stoel, bureau en laptop.
Je profiel
Je voelt je helemaal thuis in een technische omgeving en bent altijd op de hoogte van de nieuwste technologieën. Bovendien ben je een goede communicator (in het Nederlands en Engels) en ben je gewend aan een agile/scrum-werkwijze. Denk je dat je bij ons past? Bekijk je profiel en solliciteer als je jezelf (gedeeltelijk) herkent in de volgende vereiste vaardigheden:
Ervaring met GenAI (LLM, RAG)
Ervaring met werken met cloudtechnologieën
Ervaring met Java/Kotlin en Python
Affiniteit met data science
De Nederlandse taal machtig
Wij bieden
Wij vinden het belangrijk om een goede werkgever te zijn. Bij ons werken betekent een rol met impact vervullen, ondersteund door uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die jouw werkplezier, ontwikkeling en welzijn bevorderen. Daarnaast bieden wij:
Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantietoeslag en een flexibel budget voor arbeidsvoorwaarden. Afhankelijk van je vaardigheden en ervaring bieden wij een salaris in Hay 8, 9 of 10.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent op de toekomst.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je rol. Wij zorgen voor een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor jou.
Ruimte voor ontspanning met vijf weken vakantie per jaar, aangevuld met twee verplichte vrije dagen. Daarnaast kun je tot vier extra weken vakantie per jaar bijkopen.
Vijf “Banking for better-days”: extra vrije dagen die je kunt gebruiken voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling of vrijwilligerswerk.
Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal: je ontvangt een ontwikkelingsbudget van €1.000 per jaar, dat kan oplopen tot €3.000.
Een jaarlijks openbaar vervoersabonnement waarmee je gratis kunt reizen door heel Nederland, zowel zakelijk als privé.Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen vind je in onze Collectieve Arbeidsovereenkomst (CAO), die van toepassing is op deze vacature.
Interesse?
Ben je geïnteresseerd? Reageer dan online op deze vacature. We horen we graag van je!
Jouw Toekomst: Inclusief, Innovatief en Duurzaam
Bij ABN AMRO geloven we in "Banking for better, for generations to come." Gelijke kansen voor iedereen vormen een belangrijk fundament, waarbij we streven naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin alle medewerkers zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Onze visie als persoonlijke bank in de digitale tijd sluit naadloos aan bij de behoefte aan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen, voortkomend uit een divers samenspel van culturen en ervaringen. We richten ons op klantbeleving, duurzaamheid en bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige bank, waarbij we gelijke beloning voor gelijk werk jaarlijks onderzoeken om eerlijke kansen te waarborgen. title: Applied Data Scientist - Intelligent Document Processing
description:
In het kort
Heb jij een Data Science-achtergrond, maar haal je minstens zoveel energie uit het begrijpen van een probleem als uit het schrijven van code? Wil jij echte impact maken en begrijp je dat een AI-systeem groter is dan alleen een model? Spreek jij de taal van zowel business stakeholders als IT? Lees dan verder!
Binnen het Doc2Data-programma werk je samen met business stakeholders om document-intensieve hypotheekprocessen slimmer, sneller, en betrouwbaarder te maken voor onze klanten en medewerkers. Je ontwikkelt oplossingen die documenten classificeren en informatie extraheren om beschikbaar te maken voor onze processen. Hiervoor gebruik je bestaande componenten, maar denk je ook mee over lange termijn behoeftes en het verbeteren van het raamwerk.
Ben jij inhoudelijk sterk én comfortabel in een complex stakeholderveld? Dan is het AI team van Home Financing de plek voor jou!
Je werk
Als Data Scientist binnen het Doc2Data-programma draag je bij aan het verbeteren en opschalen van Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) binnen hypotheekprocessen. Je werkt aan toepassingen voor documentclassificatie, data-extractie, handmatige validatie en monitoring. Binnen het Doc2Data programma bouw je doorgaans geen complexe machine-learningmodellen vanaf nul. De uitdaging zit vooral in het begrijpen van documenten, processen en gebruikersbehoeftes, en in het vertalen daarvan naar werkende AI-oplossingen met aantoonbare impact.
In deze rol ben je van begin tot eind betrokken:
Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar concrete IDP-oplossingen die hypotheekprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder maken.
Je verdiept je in documenten, processen en gebruikersbehoeftes en bepaalt welke informatie herkend, geëxtraheerd of gevalideerd moet worden.
Je ontwerpt oplossingen met bestaande AI-componenten en stuurt daarbij op impact en praktische toepasbaarheid, niet op modelcomplexiteit.
Je definieert en verbetert trainingsdata, beoordeelt extractiekwaliteit en helpt oplossingen stap voor stap beter te maken.
Je onderbouwt keuzes met analyses, experimenten en prototypes en vertaalt inzichten naar een vorm die past bij de ontvanger, zoals een advies aan een proceseigenaar of een user story voor een IT-implementatieteam.
Je werkt nauw samen met IT-teams, proceseigenaren, business analisten en domeinexperts in een complex stakeholderveld.
Je denkt actief mee over implementatie, monitoring, beheer en doorontwikkeling, zodat AI-oplossingen robuust onderdeel worden van end-to-end processen.
Werkomgeving

Binnen deze multidisciplinaire samenwerking worden data‑ en AI‑oplossingen ontwikkeld die direct bijdragen aan het verbeteren van processen en klantbediening.
Je profiel
Je bent een hands-on Data Scientist die energie krijgt van analyseren, verbeteren en samenwerken.
Je vindt het leuk om toegewijd op een inhoudelijk domein te werken en daarin echt meters te maken.
Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en business en voelt eigenaarschap voor de kwaliteit en impact van je oplossingen.
Een academisch werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur een kwantitatieve opleiding).
3-6 jaar professionele werkervaring in Advanced Analytics / Data Science / Machine Learning.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
This is Adyen
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
Sitting at the intersection of Data Engineering, Backend Engineering, and Systems Engineering, Data Platform Engineers at Adyen build the foundational layer of tooling and processes for our on-premise Big Data Platforms. These tools support 10s of products, 100s of developers, and 1000s of daily jobs that add to Adyen’s strong portfolio of capabilities.
You’ll collaborate with data engineers and ML scientists and engineers to build and roll-out these tools. Along with DataOps Engineers, you’ll develop and operate multiple big data platforms, of which the biggest is 500+ nodes, with 25k+ CPU cores, 240+ TBs of RAM, and 23+ PBs of storage capacity, running tens of thousands of spark jobs a day.
What you’ll do
You’ll be asked to both build new tools and improve the existing tooling. This role is perfect for you if you're passionate about few of the following:
Develop and maintain scalable and high performance big data platforms.
Work with distributed systems in all shapes and flavors (databases, filesystems, compute, etc.)
Identify opportunities to improve continuous release and deployment environments
Build or deploy tools to enhance data discoverability through the collection and presentation of metadata
Introduce and extend tools to enhance the quality of our data, platform-wide
Explore and introduce technologies and practices to reduce the time to insight for analysts and data scientists
Develop streaming processing applications and frameworks
Experience in infrastructure and large-scale private cloud systems
Who you are
At least 6+ years experience with Python object oriented programming.
Team player with strong communication skills
Ability to work closely with diverse stakeholders you enable (analysts, data scientists, data engineers, etc.) and depend upon (infrastructure, security, etc).
Experience developing and maintaining:
Distributed data and compute systems like Spark, Trino, Druid, etc
Data modelling tooling
DevOps pipelines and development ecosystems.
Real-time and batch data pipelines (via Kafka, Spark streaming) with an eye for frameworks, and emphasis on user friendliness and quality.
Kubernetes ecosystem (k8s, docker), and/or Hadoop ecosystems (Hive, Yarn, HDFS, Kerberos).
Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments
Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
What’s next?
Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role.
Learn more about our hiring process here
. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

title: Internship | Bottom-up modelling of truck market and fleet development
description:
About this position
This internship focuses on modelling the development of the Dutch truck fleet, with a direct impact on insights into decarbonization. You will work on the challenge of understanding the diversity in companies’ purchasing and sales behavior and translating this into a model that can ultimately be implemented in our bottom-up fleet model. This will lead to improved insights into future developments, such as the adoption rate of electric trucks.
You will become part of the Towards Zero Emission (TZE) team, where we perform system analyses that contribute to the decarbonization of the Dutch vehicle fleet..
What will be your role?
In existing analyses of the development of the Dutch truck fleet, diversity in company characteristics and behavior is often not taken into account. As a result, reality is reduced to averages, and a broader perspective on the logistics sector is missing.
During this internship, you will work on developing a model that simulates purchasing and sales behavior at the level of individual companies. You will start with a data analysis of ownership, addressing questions such as: which types of companies purchase new trucks, and which primarily buy second-hand vehicles? Based on this, you will investigate which modelling approach is most suitable and develop a module for our bottom-up fleet model. Using this model, you will analyze what these improved insights mean for the expected adoption of electric trucks and which companies may lag behind in the transition.
You will translate your findings into clear conclusions and policy-relevant recommendations. In doing so, you contribute to a better understanding of the truck fleet transition and develop your skills in data analysis, modelling, and communicating results to both researchers and policymakers.
What we expect from you
We are looking for a Master’s student in engineering management, econometrics, data science, (civil) engineering, or a similar (quantitative) field, with an interest in data analysis and modelling. You have some experience with programming, preferably in Python. You are analytical, pragmatic, and able to work in a structured way. Plus, a touch of creativity and out-of-the-box thinking will come in handy. It is important that you are curious, show initiative and enjoy working together on system analyses related to sustainability challenges. The internship preferably lasts 6 months; the exact duration and scope can be discussed. Naturally, we would like you to become an active part of the team and participate in knowledge sharing.

An internship at TNO means working in an environment where substance and impact are central. You will become part of a knowledge organisation where research and practice come together, and where experts collaborate on solutions to current societal and technological challenges.
Your internship is a period in which you can discover what suits you, where your strengths lie and what you would like to learn next. You are part of a professional working environment, gain insight into how things work in practice, and have the opportunity to build experience that goes beyond this internship alone. For many students, an internship is therefore also a first step in discovering whether TNO could be a potential next step after graduation.

About this position
In this internship, you will develop a second-by-second CO2 emission model for heavy-duty vehicles using XGBoost, building on previous work for light-duty vehicles. The main challenge is that HD vehicle mass can vary strongly with payload and is often unknown, so part of the project is to estimate the current vehicle weight from available signals and use that information in a robust predictive CO2 emission model. The final goal is to create an accurate, data-driven model that can capture real-world driving behaviour and improve CO2 emission estimation for heavy-duty transport.
What will be your role?
During the internship, the student will work on building and improving a CO2 emission model for heavy-duty vehicles using XGBoost. In practice, this means exploring real vehicle data, cleaning and preparing datasets, selecting relevant driving and vehicle features, and developing methods to estimate the vehicle’s current weight when it is not directly known. The student will train and compare models, analyse prediction performance, and help translate the results into a usable modelling approach for the wider project. Along the way, the student will learn how to work with vehicle emission data, apply machine learning in a technical research setting, and communicate findings clearly to both researchers and practitioners.
